mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (user_id, product_name, product_image, price, description, category_id, `condition`, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{price}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{condition}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT p.* FROM product p
ORDER BY p.price ASC ORDER BY p.price DESC ORDER BY p.publish_time ASC ORDER BY p.publish_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT *, MATCH(product_name, description) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AS relevance FROM product WHERE MATCH(product_name, description) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AND status = 1 ORDER BY relevance DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE MATCH(product_name, description) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AND status = 1

SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS sold_count, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price, ROUND(SUM(p.price), 2) AS total_price FROM category c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name ORDER BY product_count DESC

SELECT p.* FROM product p WHERE p.price < ( SELECT AVG(p2.price) FROM product p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id AND p2.status = 1 ) AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.price ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.price < ( SELECT AVG(p2.price) FROM product p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id AND p2.status = 1 ) AND p.status = 1

SELECT p.* FROM product p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS interaction_count FROM interaction GROUP BY product_id ) i ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(i.interaction_count, 0) DESC, p.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
